topic: Rule-corpus consumer census for the repo-rules -> .skilled/repo-rules source-root migration
research_topic: Where does every live consumer of the rule corpus live, and what breaks when the corpus moves from the repository-root repo-rules/ to the canonical .skilled/repo-rules/ with a tracked per-entry symlink farm left at the root? Q1 in-repo consumers outside specs/: every tracked file that names a rule file or the rules directory as a live path at file:line (26 router rows in REPO RULES.md, 13 rule-body backlinks to ../REPO%20RULES.md, AGENTS.md's five links, the corpus checker, the sk-doc sk-create-repo-rule skill and its manual-testing-playbook, the /create:repo-rule command and its assets, the two authored agent files, the sk-communication benchmark generator). Q2 generators, mirrors, CI and gate inputs: which of .claude/agents, .pi/agents, .codex/agents and .hermes/skills are generated and from which authored source, which script checks each, what repo-rules-corpus.yml and .github/scripts/check-gate-inputs.sh key on, and whether the trigger index, corpus-manifest, generation-diagnostics and phrase-variants artifacts can be regenerated byte-identically. Q3 external consumers and portability: what sibling repositories link into, and how check-repo-rules.cjs can probe .skilled/repo-rules before repo-rules while keeping its nine checks and resolving router rows by link target.
